title: Libra skated alone. Wobbled beautifully.
caption: Everyone at the rink seems to be in pairs this time of year. Go anyway. Wobble, fall a little, find your glide, then buy yourself the cocoa. Send this to the friend who keeps waiting for a skating partner.
